reviewNotes.note: Sidebar metadata and knowledge/session subtitles use date-fns formatDistanceToNow with the default locale, so relative times such as '2 hours ago' stay in English whatever the UI language is. Localizing them needs a date-fns locale mapping, which is a Phase B code decision, not a dictionary entry.
src/app.html hard-codes <html lang="en"> and the static <title>Hollama</title>. Phase B should consider setting lang dynamically when the locale changes. Not a translatable dictionary entry.

reviewNotes.topic: Language names in the language selector
reviewNotes.note: Settings › Interface lists each language by its own native name (English, Deutsch, 中文 (简体), Español, ...). These look like translatable strings but are intentionally not translated; Catalan should be added as 'Català'. Left out of the export on purpose.

reviewNotes.topic: Example placeholder values in Connection settings
reviewNotes.note: The model filter input uses the fixed placeholder 'gpt' and the label input uses 'my-llama-server'. Both are example values rather than prose, so they are not exported; decide in Phase B whether they should become translatable or stay fixed.

reviewNotes.topic: GitHub link label in the sidebar
reviewNotes.note: The sidebar renders a link with the literal text 'GitHub'. It is a product name and is intentionally not translatable.

The /motd page renders src/routes/motd/motd.md, which is authored English content, not interface chrome. It is user-facing but out of scope for the dictionary; the project would need a content-translation decision (per-locale markdown) if it should be localized.

Toast descriptions sometimes show values produced outside the app: Ollama pull progress statuses (response.status, e.g. 'pulling manifest'), server error messages (response.error) and raw JS error strings (error.toString()). These are protocol/model output and should not be translated; only the surrounding generic titles are in the dictionary.

reviewNotes.topic: Thrown error messages in the chat layer
reviewNotes.note: src/lib/chat/ollama.ts throws English Error messages such as 'Ollama response is missing body', 'Failed to fetch Ollama tags' and 'Failed to parse Ollama tags'. They are developer-facing but can reach the UI through error.toString() in the chat error toast description. Decide whether to translate them as technical detail or keep them in English.

electron/main.js shows Electron's native dialog.showErrorBox('Error', error.message). This runs outside the Svelte i18n runtime and cannot use typesafe-i18n directly; decide separately whether the desktop shell should be localized.

Eight keys have no use site in the current source tree and are exported unchanged so the key set stays identical to src/i18n/en/index.ts: dangerZone, disconnected, goToKnowledge, modelNotFound, noApiKey, somethingWentWrong, stopResponse, version. Confirm whether they should be translated or dropped from the English base dictionary before Phase B.

Several entries are sentence fragments completed by inline elements at the call site: allowConnections (origin badge + 'See docs' link), browseModels (library link), creatingTunnel and allowMixedContent (joined by 'or' plus a literal final period), couldntCheckForUpdates and isCurrentVersionLatest (followed by links), isLatestVersion (followed by a version badge and link), tryingToConnectNotLocalhost (HTML with inline code badges). The translator must keep them fragment-shaped so the pieces still read correctly together.
